USDT-ETH pool is a liquidity pool that pairs the USDT token with the ETH token. USDT-ETH pool holds its two assets in a shared pool for trading.

Unizen is a decentralized exchange aggregator. Unizen routes token swaps across multiple decentralized exchanges.
